name: Mancleaver Mantis
body:
Mancleaver Mantis
CR 5

XP 1,600
N Large vermin
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 10, flat-footed 16 (+1 Dex, +7 natural, -1 size)
hp 57 (6d8+30)
Fort +10, Ref +3, Will +4
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft. fly 40 ft. (poor)
Melee 2 claws +10 (1d8+7 plus grab), bite +5 (1d6+3)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks mandibles, sudden strike

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 13, Con 20, Int —, Wis 14, Cha 11
Base Atk +4; CMB +12 (+16 grapple); CMD 23 (27 vs. trip)
Feats LungeB
Skills Climb +15, Fly -5, Perception +6, Stealth +5; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +8 Stealth

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Mandibles (Ex)

The bite of a mancleaver mantis is a secondary natural attack. When succeeding at a combat maneuver check to maintain grapple, a mancleaver mantis can make a single bite attack against the grappled victim as a free action.

Sudden Strike (Ex)

A mancleaver mantis can strike with both claws when making an attack action. This allows the giant mantis to make attacks of opportunity or attack during a surprise round with both claws.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests
Organization solitary
Treasure none

A mancleaver mantis is over 7 feet tall, 15 feet long and weighs over a ton.
